steps.text: how do we roll out the new parser without breaking every document?
we could ship it behind a flag to 5% of rooms, or swap everyone at once after the migration.
flag plus dual-read sounds safer. canary rooms first.
dual-read is another implementation detail; the choice is staged vs all at once.
I'd do the 5% canary. we can stop it if the mismatch metric moves.
yes, staged. but let's set the rollback threshold before flipping it.
